stick.hat.trim.name: Trim hat up (ND); hat also NU/LWD/RWD + push
stick.hat.trim.note: hat on top of the head, seen in profile (ribbed cap with centre push)

stick.pinky.lever.name: Paddle switch
stick.pinky.lever.note: metal emergency-autopilot-disable paddle at the lower front

stick.pinky.button.name: Pinky switch
stick.pinky.button.note: black cylindrical push button at the lower front, just above the paddle mount; matched to 'Pinky switch' by position

stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: grip connector; add-on grip, base not on the photo

stick.button.thumb.1.name: Weapon select push (positions SP/PH, SW, GUN, OFF)
stick.button.thumb.1.note: ammo selector lever on the top left of the head (push = button), seen in profile; its SP/PH-SW-GUN-OFF labels face the pilot (main)

stick.button.thumb.2.name: Side button
stick.button.thumb.2.note: white side button on the side plate

unplaced.stick.weapon_release: red button on the right top of the head, hidden behind the head on this view (see main)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), add-on grip seen from the left (thumb side), front to the left: ammo selector lever and hat on top (in profile), DLC wheel and white side button on the side plate, red trigger, metal paddle and pinky button at the lower front
mappingSource: catalog only (vkb.json: control names from the MobiFlight Gladiator EVO F14 map https://github.com/MobiFlight/MobiFlight-Connector/blob/main/src/MobiFlightConnector/Joysticks/vkbsim/vkbsim_gladiator_evo_f14.joystick.json; no Gunfighter factory numbering, parts have no inputs); physical controls from the product page https://vkbsimcontrollers.com/products/f-14-add-on-grip-for-gunfighter-mk-iv-us (hat with centre push, dual-stage trigger, 4-stage ammo selector with safety lock and push button, metal emergency-autopilot-disable trigger, DLC wheel, 4 buttons). vkbsimcontrollers.com/pages/downloads has no F-14 template.
note: The red weapon-release button sits on the right top of the head, hidden behind the head on this photo (visible on main at 0.620 0.195 and gallery-6). The DLC wheel (knurled wheel above the side plate, ~0.525 0.445) and the twist have no catalog parts; the large round disc on the left of the head is a cover, not a control. main (rear-left view) shows red button, hat, selector with its SP/PH-SW-GUN-OFF labels and the side button clearly, but trigger and paddle only edge-on and not the pinky button; this side view places 7 of 8 parts.
